text:
Alex Chen: Hey folks — PR #21401 is ready. It includes a tiny DB migration + feature flag. Need to land before the weekend deploy freeze if possible. CI still running; can someone eyeball mac-e2e and integration? Rebase window tonight per calendar.

Maria Lopez: I can run the local migration tests. Note: migration adds a nullable column, but we should add a short release note. @sam can you do the security quick-check?

Samir Patel: Giving eyes now. CI shows mac-e2e failing with a flakey test. Re-run queued. If it keeps flaking, we shouldn't land into the freeze. What's the rebase window timeframe?

Alex Chen: Release calendar lists a 1h rebase window 22:00–23:00 UTC tonight. If we get green before ~22:15 UTC I can merge at 22:30. Otherwise we postpone until after the freeze. @release-manager any blockers from your side?

Release Bot: Reminder: deploy freeze starts Mon 02:00 UTC. Rebase windows tonight between 22:00–23:00 UTC only. No merges allowed during freeze.

CI Bot: Automated status: job mac-e2e failed (run 78234). Failure snippet:
```
FAIL tests/e2e/test_permissions.py::test_user_edit - AssertionError: expected 200 but got 500
Traceback: AssertionError at tests/e2e/test_permissions.py:42
```
Re-run recommended: `ci rerun job mac-e2e --pr 21401`.

Priya Nair: I'll take the mac flake. Re-running the job now and watching logs. Also pinging infra in case runner capacity is starving the job.

Priya Nair: Ran `ci rerun job mac-e2e --pr 21401` — queued (job 78235). ETA ~7m.

Todd Green: If we hit a merge conflict after rebase, I can help resolve quickly. Tag me and I’ll prioritize.

Samir Patel: If rerun still flakes, proposal: do a canary merge on the dedicated canary lane (low traffic) with a kill-switch env `FEATURE_21401=off` so rollback is immediate. Thoughts?

Maria Lopez: +1 for canary if CI remains unhappy. Also prefer running migration in canary first, then backfill. Avoid running the migration during US peak hours.

Alex Chen: Plan suggestion: Priya reruns and monitors mac-e2e. Samir watches integration lanes. If everything green by 22:15 UTC we merge in the 22:30 window. If not, we defer to Monday post-freeze. Assigning reviewers: @Maria Lopez and @Todd Green. @Release Manager please mark calendar.

Release Manager: Noted. I’ll update the calendar and set a hold if we defer. Also adding rollback playbook link: https://tiny.redwood/rollback-21401. Please add a short post-merge note if we proceed.

Priya Nair: mac-e2e passed on rerun (job 78235) — logs look clean. Integration jobs still running (db-integ slow).

Samir Patel: Integration green on staging, e2e green in canary. Looks safe. Maria, Todd — can you give final approval in the PR?

Maria Lopez: Reviewing now. Left one tiny comment about a log line, will approve after fix.

Todd Green: Approved from my side. If Maria's log change is minor, we can land and do a quick patch after.

Maria Lopez: Comment addressed and pushed. Approving now.

Alex Chen: Great — merging at 22:30 UTC during the rebase window. Will watch metrics and set `FEATURE_21401=off` if anything spikes. Thanks all :rocket: :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: I'll be on standby to flip the kill-switch and coordinate rollback if needed.

Release Manager: Merge observed. Notifying infra to watch the canary lane for 30m. If any rollback happens, please post in this thread.

Alex Chen: Post-merge: migrations started and completed on canary. No errors. Scheduling controlled rollout to 10% traffic in 15m.

Priya Nair: All good from mac runners. No regressions.

Maria Lopez: Backfill scheduled for off-peak window tomorrow. Closing my review items.

Todd Green: Thanks team.

CI Bot: All CI checks passed for merge commit 8f3a2b.

Alex Chen: Closing thread — thanks for quick turnaround everyone.
